title: Admission controller bounds concurrent requests and manages capacity overload

test_cases.name: Rejects requests exceeding max_analyses threshold
test_cases.input_setup: AdmissionController with max_analyses=2 and mock active=2
test_cases.evidence: check_analysis raised AdmissionRejectedError at capacity limit

test_cases.name: Rejects websockets exceeding max_websockets threshold
test_cases.input_setup: AdmissionController with max_websockets=5 and mock active=5
test_cases.evidence: check_websocket raised AdmissionRejectedError at socket limit

test_cases.name: acquire_analysis_slot manages lifetime bounds
test_cases.input_setup: Enter and exit acquire_analysis_slot context manager
test_cases.expected_result: increment called on enter, decrement called on exit
test_cases.evidence: acquire_analysis_slot cleanly managed increment and decrement lifecycle

test_cases.name: Slot released safely when exception occurs
test_cases.input_setup: Raise exception inside acquire_analysis_slot context manager
test_cases.expected_result: decrement called ensuring no slot leak
test_cases.evidence: Slot released immediately even when task raises exception

test_cases.name: Stats reporting calculates utilization ratios
test_cases.input_setup: Query AdmissionController.stats under mocked active counts
test_cases.expected_result: Accurate utilization ratios calculated for both analyses and websockets
